selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish it from other jewelry types like bracelets.
To verify that the small chain links are physically connected and not fused, and that the pendants are separate entities attached via jump rings.
To check for AI artifacts in the complex embossed textures of the pendants and the consistency of metallic reflections.

focus_areas: Connectivity of small chain links (fusion detection)
Physical attachment points of pendants to the chain
Consistency of embossed patterns on pendants
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the pendants attach to the main chain. AI often fails to render the small jump rings or loops correctly, resulting in floating pendants or fused metal. Also, inspect the 'rope' texture of the chain links for repetitive pattern errors or melting.
